en.headline: Observatory expects a fine, dry weekend with highs near 31
en.dek: Saturday and Sunday should stay fine and dry under an east to northeast breeze, with temperatures between 26 and 31 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory expects a fine and dry weekend, with no rain in its Saturday or Sunday outlook and daytime highs around 31 degrees Celsius.

In the seven-day forecast updated at 11:30am on Friday, the Observatory said Saturday would be fine and dry during the day, with an east to northeast wind of force 4 and temperatures from 26 to 31 degrees. Relative humidity was forecast between 50 and 80 per cent. Sunday was given the same wind, the same temperature range and the same fine, dry description.

The Observatory said an anticyclone aloft would keep the weather generally fine over southern China in the coming days, while the northeast monsoon affecting the coast would moderate gradually early next week. It also said it would be hot during the day over the region. Monday was forecast fine and dry again, still between 26 and 31 degrees, before Tuesday turns dry and hot with a high of 32 degrees.

No tropical cyclone signal, rainstorm warning or thunderstorm warning was in force for Hong Kong when the outlook was issued. The Observatory recorded a sea surface temperature of 27 degrees at North Point at 7am on Friday.

zh.headline: 天文台料周末天晴乾燥 最高氣溫約31度
zh.dek: 周六及周日預料天晴、日間乾燥，吹東至東北風4級，氣溫約26至31度。
body: 香港天文台預料本周末天晴乾燥，周六、周日的展望均沒有提到降雨，日間最高氣溫約31度。
天文台周五上午11時30分更新的七天天氣預報指，周六天晴，日間乾燥，吹東至東北風4級，氣溫26至31度，相對濕度約50%至80%。周日風勢、氣溫範圍及天氣描述相同，同樣是天晴、日間乾燥。
天文台表示，高空反氣旋主導下，華南未來數天天氣大致良好；影響沿岸的東北季候風會在下周初逐漸緩和，區內日間炎熱。周一仍料天晴乾燥，氣溫26至31度；周二則日間乾燥炎熱，最高約32度。
展望發出時，本港並無熱帶氣旋警告、暴雨警告或雷暴警告生效。天文台錄得周五上午7時北角海面溫度為27度。
